import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 200;
    static final int maxm = 100000;
    static final int inf = 199999999;

    static int[][] ma = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] mat = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int n, N, t;
    static String s;
    static int[][] hu = new int[maxn][3];
    static int[][] re = new int[maxn][3];
    static int zr, zc;
    static int cx, cy;
    static int[][] stran = {{0,-1},{0,1},{-1,0},{1,0}};

    static int[][][] edge = new int[maxm][3]; // st, ed, flow
    static int[] head = new int[maxn];
    static int E;
    static int src, dest;

    static int[] dis = new int[maxn];
    static int[] qu = new int[maxm];
    static int[] inq = new int[maxn];

    static int isok(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && ma[r][c] != -1) {
            return (r-1)*n + c;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static void BG() {
        N = n * n;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) Arrays.fill(mat[i], -1);
        for (int r1 = 1; r1 <= n; r1++) {
            for (int c1 = 1; c1 <= n; c1++) {
                if (ma[r1][c1] == -1) continue;
                int p1 = (r1-1)*n + c1;
                mat[p1][p1] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    int r2 = r1 + stran[i][0];
                    int c2 = c1 + stran[i][1];
                    if (r2 > 0 && r2 <= n && c2 > 0 && c2 <= n && ma[r2][c2] != -1) {
                        int p2 = (r2-1)*n + c2;
                        mat[p1][p2] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, inf);
        int fr = 0;
        int rr = 1;
        int dd = (zr-1)*n + zc;
        dis[dd] = 0;
        qu[0] = dd;
        while (fr < rr) {
            int now = qu[fr++];
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                if (mat[now][i] == 1 && dis[i] > dis[now] + 1) {
                    dis[i] = dis[now] + 1;
                    qu[rr++] = i;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Floyd() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                for (int z = 1; z <= N; z++) {
                    if (mat[j][i] != -1 && mat[i][z] != -1) {
                        if (mat[j][z] == -1 || mat[j][z] > mat[j][i] + mat[i][z]) {
                            mat[j][z] = mat[j][i] + mat[i][z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addedge(int st, int ed, int flow) {
        edge[E][0] = st; edge[E][1] = ed; edge[E][2] = flow; edge[E][3] = head[st]; // next stored in index 3
        // We'll store next separately: let's adjust. We'll use a separate array for next.
        // Actually, we'll store edge as object? Simpler: use arrays: st, ed, flow, next.
        // Let's redefine: edge[E][0]=st, edge[E][1]=ed, edge[E][2]=flow, edge[E][3]=head[st]
        head[st] = E++;
        edge[E][0] = ed; edge[E][1] = st; edge[E][2] = 0; edge[E][3] = head[ed];
        head[ed] = E++;
    }

    // We need to store next in the edge array. Since we have 4 columns, we'll use:
    // edge[i][0] = st, edge[i][1] = ed, edge[i][2] = flow, edge[i][3] = next
    // Then head array holds index of first edge.
    static int[][] edge = new int[maxm][4];
    static int[] head = new int[maxn];
    static int E;

    // We'll rewrite the data structures and functions accordingly.
    // Let's redo with proper arrays.

    static void initEdges() {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxm; i++) Arrays.fill(edge[i], 0);
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        E = 0;
    }

    static void BF() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = cx + cy + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            addedge(src, i, hu[i][2]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= cy; i++) {
            addedge(cx + i, dest, re[i][2]);
        }
        int dd = (zr-1)*n + zc;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= cy; j++) {
                int p1 = (hu[i][0]-1)*n + hu[i][1];
                int p2 = (re[j][0]-1)*n + re[j][1];
                if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] < dis[p2]) {
                    addedge(i, cx + j, inf);
                } else if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] == dis[p2]) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                        int rr = re[j][0] + stran[z][0];
                        int cc = re[j][1] + stran[z][1];
                        int pp = isok(rr, cc);
                        if (pp != -1) {
                            if (mat[p1][pp] == mat[p1][p2] - 1 && mat[p1][pp] < dis[pp]) {
                                addedge(i, cx + j, inf);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] d = new int[maxn];
    static boolean dinic_bfs() {
        int[] que = new int[maxn];
        int front = 0, rear = 1;
        que[0] = src;
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        while (front < rear) {
            int now = que[front++];
            for (int i = head[now]; i != -1; i = edge[i][3]) {
                int ed = edge[i][1];
                if (d[ed] == -1 && edge[i][2] > 0) {
                    d[ed] = d[now] + 1;
                    if (ed == dest) return d[dest] >= 0;
                    que[rear++] = ed;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int[] stk = new int[maxn];
    static int[] cur = new int[maxn];
    static int dinic() {
        int ret = 0;
        int minf;
        while (dinic_bfs()) {
            int u = src, tail = 0;
            for (int i = src; i <= dest; i++) cur[i] = head[i];
            while (cur[src] != -1) {
                if (u != dest && cur[u] != -1 && edge[cur[u]][2] > 0 && d[u] != -1 && d[u] + 1 == d[edge[cur[u]][1]]) {
                    stk[tail++] = cur[u];
                    u = edge[cur[u]][1];
                } else if (u == dest) {
                    minf = inf;
                    for (int i = tail-1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        if (edge[stk[i]][2] < minf) minf = edge[stk[i]][2];
                    }
                    for (ret += minf, i = tail-1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        edge[stk[i]][2] -= minf;
                        edge[stk[i] ^ 1][2] += minf;
                        if (edge[stk[i]][2] == 0) tail = i;
                    }
                    u = edge[stk[tail]][0];
                } else {
                    while (tail > 0 && u != src && cur[u] == -1) u = edge[stk[--tail]][0];
                    cur[u] = edge[cur[u]][3];
                }
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int solve() {
        ma[zr][zc] = 0;
        BG();
        spfa();
        ma[zr][zc] = -1;
        BG();
        Floyd();
        BF();
        int ret = dinic();
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        cx = cy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) Arrays.fill(ma[i], 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    ma[i][j+1] = -1;
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    zr = i;
                    zc = j+1;
                    ma[i][j+1] = -1;
                } else if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    cx++;
                    hu[cx][0] = i;
                    hu[cx][1] = j+1;
                    hu[cx][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    cy++;
                    re[cy][0] = i;
                    re[cy][1] = j+1;
                    re[cy][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve());
        sc.close();
    }
}
